thread.title: Dow stages powerful reversal to end higher, but tech stocks sink a 3rd session in a row - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow stages powerful reversal to end higher, but tech stocks sink a 3rd session in a row - MarketWatch
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.15% on Monday managed a potent intraday reversal to eke out a modest gain, but technology shares declined for a third straight session as a period of rising rates knocked equity benchmarks around. The bond market was closed in observance of Columbus Day. The Dow DJIA, +0.15% ended by up about 40 points, or 0.2%, at 26,487, but the S&P 500 index SPX, -0.04% finished the session less than 0.1% lower at 2,884, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.67% closed down 0.7% at 7,736. marking its third down day in succession for the tech and internet-related benchmark. Monday's action was a continuation of Friday's stumbles which were sparked, at least in part, by a surge of the yield of the 10-year Treasury note TMUBMUSD10Y, +1.37% on Friday to 3.23%--the highest level since 2011. Bond prices fall as yields rise. Rising yields mean higher borrowing costs for corporations and climbing rates can also make stocks comparatively less attractive than Treasurys, which are perceived as risk-free assets. Rising rates have been a particular headwind to stocks that had helped partly drive stocks to new records, including Netflix Inc. NFLX, -0.64% Facebook Inc. FB, -0.05% Google-parent Alphabet GOOG, -0.72% GOOGL, -1.02% Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.23% and Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -1.34% but have since been under pressure.
